summary: 硬岩矿在调试期即使已经产出锂辉石精矿，也不代表这些吨数已经成为可销售、可被下游稳定使用的供给；Li2O品位、铁/云母等杂质、水分、粒度或批次稳定性不达客户要求时，产品可能需要重新配矿、返工、掺混、折价或延后发运。
why_search_may_miss_it: 矿企公告常把首批精矿或精矿产量当作里程碑，但产品验收、返工、掺混和客户规格问题可能只出现在运营更新、技术报告或买方沟通中。

recalled_details.gap_reason: the compact layer distinguishes first concentrate, grade and recovery, but does not yet model customer-acceptable or saleable concentrate as a separate effective-supply state
recalled_details.replay_link: could reduce contemporaneously available SC6-equivalent supply relative to headline concentrate production during 2018-2020 ramps and explain why nameplate additions did not translate one-for-one into converter feed

suggested_queries: spodumene concentrate off spec customer acceptance qualification mica iron ramp
lithium mine concentrate off-spec blending reprocessing customer specification
disconfirmation_queries: all concentrate counted as hard-rock lithium production during commissioning was immediately saleable and accepted by customers without quality adjustment

summary: 硬岩矿供给的可比物料平衡应把采出矿石、ROM矿堆、入选矿量、选矿回收率、精矿产量、精矿库存和实际发运分别记录；爬坡期可能用之前积累的ROM矿堆支撑选厂，也可能在精矿产出后先形成成品库存，因此某一季度的采矿量、精矿产量和销售量并非同一供给时点。
why_search_may_miss_it: 数据库通常只保留一个production字段，ROM与精矿库存又可能分散在不同运营表格，导致跨季度库存移动被误判成新增或消失的供给。

recalled_details.gap_reason: existing leads separately cover recovery and concentrate stockpile, but the compact layer does not yet connect them into one auditable ore-to-shipment material-balance chain
recalled_details.replay_link: would prevent 2019-2020 replay from comparing mine output, concentrate production and shipments as if they represented the same contemporaneous effective supply

suggested_queries: lithium mine ROM stockpile ore processed concentrate production shipments reconciliation
spodumene quarterly ore mined ore milled recovery concentrate inventory sales
disconfirmation_queries: reported hard-rock lithium concentrate production can be reconciled to shipments without ROM or finished-goods inventory adjustments

summary: 新硬岩矿从commissioning到稳定产量期间，管理层往往会连续修订矿石处理量、回收率、精矿产量、发运量和达到nameplate的时间；历史供给预测若只保留最初目标或最终实际值，会丢失市场在每个时点如何逐步下调或延后‘即将到来的吨数’。
why_search_may_miss_it: 后来的公司演示和数据库通常覆盖旧指导值，搜索结果容易保留最新目标而不是按日期保存每一次修订。

recalled_details.gap_reason: the compact layer has project-pipeline expectation leads and final ramp outcomes, but not the project-level sequence of contemporaneous ramp-guidance revisions
recalled_details.replay_link: provides the Expectation trajectory needed to compare what the market could reasonably count as 2019-2020 supply at each historical date against later realized output

suggested_queries: spodumene mine ramp production guidance revision recovery shipment commissioning
lithium project quarterly guidance ramp nameplate revised production
disconfirmation_queries: major hard-rock lithium ramps reached original production and recovery guidance without material timing revisions

summary: 精矿已经产出后，港口堆存、船批大小、装船窗口、买方验收和合同中的所有权转移点仍会让production、shipment和sales recognition跨季度错位；尤其在新矿爬坡或价格快速下行时，单看发运量可能低估当期产出，单看产量又可能高估当期真正进入下游的可用吨数。
why_search_may_miss_it: 运营摘要常把生产、发运和销售拆在不同表格或只强调其中一个指标，合同所有权与验收时点更少进入供给数据库。

recalled_details.gap_reason: HR-G007 already identifies mine production-versus-sales stockpile, but port/parcel/title-transfer and customer-acceptance timing add a distinct reconciliation path between finished concentrate and realized downstream availability
recalled_details.replay_link: could explain quarter-level divergences in 2019-2020 between reported production, shipped tonnes, recognized sales and converter-available feed without inventing new physical capacity

suggested_queries: spodumene concentrate port inventory shipment sales recognition title transfer
lithium concentrate production shipments sales port stockpile quarterly
disconfirmation_queries: hard-rock concentrate production, shipment and sales recognition occur in the same period with immaterial logistics or title timing differences

summary: 锂价下跌时在产硬岩矿会通过提高cut-off grade、减少边际矿处理、延后剥采或把低品位矿留在stockpile来降低短期供给，而高价时可能反向处理边际矿和历史矿堆；这种mine-plan重优化会让在产供给呈现价格弹性。
why_search_may_miss_it: 矿山工程调整通常藏在技术报告或运营解释中，不会直接出现在宏观锂供给标题里。

recalled_details.gap_reason: this mechanism was reactivated by the effective-supply audit, but HR-H006 in the current compact index already resolves materially the same price-driven mine-plan and stockpile response
recalled_details.replay_link: retained as a duplicate observation so novelty decay is measured honestly rather than rewriting an existing supply-response mechanism until it appears new

suggested_queries: lithium mine cutoff grade stockpile price mine plan optimization
spodumene mine low grade stockpile price response
disconfirmation_queries: hard-rock mine plans and cutoff grades are invariant to lithium price through the cycle
